title: Thinking on Learning to Change our Thoughts
summary: Kahran and Divya unpack a Buddhist saying — the way you do one thing is the way you do everything — by testing it on themselves. They walk through the unconscious-incompetence-to-unconscious-competence ladder, Divya frames learning rates as derivatives (distance, velocity, acceleration), and Kahran borrows Magic the Gathering mana to explain why he can only write poetry for 20 minutes a day under specific conditions.
topics: is the way you do one thing the way you do everything
muscle memory and system one thinking
energy you have for tedious admin

intents.display: to think about how we learn and the way we do everything
